record.name: AI Trade Algo
record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Introducing Stock Algo, a powerful app designed to provide traders with accurate and reliable trading signals. Whether you're a seasoned trader looking to validate your strategies or a beginner aiming to develop your own, Stock Algo offers a robust framework to support your trading journey. The app empowers you to customize signal sensitivity based on your trading style, allowing you to fine-tune the level of precision you desire.
 
One of the key features of Stock Algo is the Reversal Bands. These bands act as valuable tools to identify potential reversals in the market. By utilizing derivative calculations of averages, the app effectively pinpoints Reversal Patterns, highlighting instances where the market exhibits signs of being oversold or overbought. With the Reversal Bands, you can anticipate pullbacks or reversals, enabling you to take advantage of profitable trading opportunities.
 
Another powerful tool offered by Stock Algo is the Energy Clouds. By enabling the volatility cloud feature, you can gauge the prevailing market volatility. The expanding cloud indicates a trending market, while a contracted or smaller cloud suggests a sideways market. The Volatility Cloud not only helps you time your entry and exit points but also allows you to analyze market uptrends and downtrends using the Moving Average Cloud. By observing the price in relation to the Moving Average Cloud, you can identify uptrends, downtrends, or sideways market conditions.
 
Stock Algo is designed to be user-friendly and intuitive, making it accessible to traders of all experience levels. With its visually appealing charts and illustrations, the app presents complex data in a clear and understandable manner. Whether you're a swing trader seeking long-lasting trades or a day trader looking for frequent opportunities, Stock Algo caters to your specific trading preferences. Premium subscription is required to access all signals, free users can only access limited number of signals. 
 
Payment will be charged from your iTunes Account after you confirm it. As a user, you have the ability to manage your subscriptions, and if you don't want them to renew automatically, you can turn off the auto-renewal feature by accessing your Account Settings after the purchase. If you choose not to turn off the auto-renewal, the subscription will renew automatically unless you disable it in your App Store settings at least 24 hours before the current subscription period ends. It's important to note that if you purchase a subscription and decide to cancel it, you will lose the remaining time of your current subscription period.
 
Privacy Policy: https://www.masicorpltd.com/simple/privacy/
Terms of Use:  https://www.masicorpltd.com/simple/terms/
 
Download Stock Algo now and take your trading skills to the next level. Unleash the power of meticulously researched algorithms and make smarter trading decisions with confidence.

record.name: Hey Penny: Your Money AI Buddy
record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Meet Penny, your sassy AI financial sidekick!  Budgeting? Ain't nobody got time for that! Penny automatically tracks your spending, categorizes everything, and keeps you on track – with minimal effort from you. Forget those other apps that demand your constant attention. Penny lives right in your iMessage, so you can check your finances, ask questions, and get instant answers without even opening an app.

Need to know if you’ve blown through eating out?  Just shoot her a message and she’ll even come up with past spending patterns so you can make your own decision if that fancy steak can wait – or not!

PASSIVE PERSONAL FINANCE – Our Mantra

We leverage the power of AI to give you the financial insights you need, so you can focus on life and not on staring at charts.

AI-powered spending categorization that learns your preferences
Ask Penny to create categorization rules in plain English
Forecasts future spending and alerts you when you're overspending
Track your spending by relying on Penny's Insights

AI-POWERED SPENDING CATEGORIZATION

We've trained Penny on millions of establishments to accurately categorize your spending. Over 90% of your purchases will be automatically and accurately categorized with no effort from you. For those tricky businesses that sell a bit of everything, we've got you covered! Penny analyzes their typical sales to suggest the most likely categories, saving you from scrolling through endless category lists.

We're all different, and you can tell Penny how you want things categorized – in plain English! Walmart trips are groceries? Got you covered! Penny learns from your actions and adapts to your preferences.


FORECAST SPENDING AND FINANCIAL INSIGHTS

With no work from you, Penny builds a picture of your spending habits. This gives her a unique understanding of your spending patterns, highlighting areas where you might be overspending or even underspending to reach your financial goals. We don't believe in unattainable budgets. Penny guides you to spend sustainably on what makes you happy and less on things you could care less about.

She'll even find those pesky subscriptions and remind you if you're still using them. Penny will reach out in iMessage, just like a friend.

APP DESIGNED TO BE OUT OF YOUR WAY
We've designed the app's home page to provide instant, simplified information. A single tap on the chart drills down into the details if you want to take a closer look. We've made a significant effort to make the app immediately useful, so you don't have to spend precious minutes just to see if that refund came in. Maybe you shouldn't be using the app at all – just ask Penny!
Everything's in the Dashboard: Penny even explains why those few purchases couldn't be categorized. Maybe the establishment sells a wide variety of things, or perhaps you spent an unusually high amount there.

PENNY IS STILL LEARNING

We've done our best to make Penny accurate, clear, and even funny, but we're still in early Beta. We can only support a limited number of users, so you might be put on a waitlist as our AI servers get up to speed. We don't track investments yet, but that's on the roadmap. We want Penny to be helpful in your day-to-day spending decisions, not just your investment strategies – but we'll get there!

Shape Penny's Future

Tell us how you want to shape Penny – by telling Penny directly! We are in the early days of our journey to help you passively manage your spending so you can maximize happiness in your life.

record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review

Collaborative smart calendar for your finances with a spark of AI.

Track and forecast your money as easily as adding events to a calendar! Dollarbird helps you make sense of your financial situation, plan ahead and manage your money together with those who matter.

“It’s a delight to use.” - The Next Web 

“Dollarbird makes sense for anyone who wants to keep a closer eye on their cash flow for better financial planning purposes.” - TechCrunch 

Also featured in Mashable, Lifehacker, The Guardian, iMore, TUAW, etc. 

It comes with:
• A simple calendar-based interface where you can add, keep track and visualize your transactions.
• Automatic balance forecasting that learns from your spending habits and predicts how your balance will evolve over time
• Advanced AI that learns over time and makes categorization easier.
• Option to collaborate with your partner, family or team to manage your finances and stay up to date on common money matters. 
• Your data stored in the cloud, available on all your devices regardless of the platform you’re rocking on.

Dollarbird offers auto-renewable in-app purchases to access Pro features that allow you to collaborate with your family or team. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. If auto-renewal is not turned off, your iTunes account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. The renewal cost will be the same as the currently active subscription cost. Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes & App Store Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

Andy - “Love it I have been using dollarbird for years now and absolutely love it. The only one of its kind, has helped over the years to make sure I never overspend!”

Heather - “Holy budgeting awesome! Who knew tracking payments and expenditures could be so pretty??”

Ariel - “Excellent This is exactly what I have been looking for! I don't need all of the fancy finance stuff, just a simple way to see what will be in my account each day based on pre-planned bills/expenses. :)”

I like the future income and expense forecast feature. I've downloaded literally 25 different apps over the years and I continue to use this one with no complaints.”

Emily - “This app changed my life. Works great, intuitive, doesn't link to your bank account, just easy way to record all your purchases. I love the clean simple design. I've used it nonstop since I downloaded it!!”

Note: You need to sign up for a user account to be able to use Dollarbird. You can do this on the first screen after the app starts by tapping on the "Sign Up" button.

Zing is the ultimate AI Coach, revolutionizing fitness with AI-powered, personalized workouts designed by top health and fitness experts. Whether you're a beginner or an advanced athlete, Zing AI Coach adapts to your needs, offering real-time insights and support for a transformative fitness journey.

Advanced AI Coach

The AI Coach engages proactively, suggesting goals, scheduling workouts, and providing real-time form monitoring and feedback. It checks in daily about your energy levels, mood, and sleep, adjusting your workout plan in real-time to ensure continuous improvement.

Zing Vision

Our advanced Zing Vision technology uses your smartphone's camera to track movements in real-time, providing detailed insights to improve your technique.

AI Body Scan

Zing's AI Body Scan analyzes your body composition using your smartphone's camera. Receive insights into body fat, lean mass, and more, integrated into your fitness plan for a hyper-personalized experience. Photos are promptly deleted for privacy.

Hyper-Personalized Plans

Zing creates customized workout plans based on your unique body data, fitness background, and lifestyle. It dynamically adjusts workout intensity and complexity based on your progress, goals, and activity levels. The Strength Score helps you track and enhance your strength training, setting clear goals through increased workout intensity and repetitions.

Dynamic AI Workout Progression

Zing's AI adjusts your workout intensity and complexity continuously. Centralize all your activity data in Zing for detailed fitness insights. Seamlessly integrate with Apple Watch and Apple Health. Track your daily activity, earn milestones, and share achievements with friends for added encouragement.

World-Class Training

Zing Coach generates intuitive workouts from almost 500 exercises, adapting to your preferences and goals. It tracks muscle fatigue levels, ensuring safe and effective training sessions.

Diverse Workout Types

Zing offers various workout types including strength, HIIT, stretching, and recovery, with Pilates and yoga coming soon. Each type is designed to enhance different aspects of fitness, from muscle development and fat burn to flexibility and mind-body connection.

Fitness and Flexibility Tests

Take the Fitness Test to assess your current fitness level and the Flexibility Test to measure your mobility. Get personalized insights for your plan based on your results, and improve them with targeted exercises.

Community and Support

Join a vibrant community of over a million users. Participate in monthly challenges, invite friends to your Fitness Circle, and connect with others in our Facebook group. Zing Coach fosters a supportive environment that celebrates transformation and progress.

Subscription Plans

We offer a wide range of subscription options so that you can choose the right one for you (3 months access renewal, weekly renewal, etc.). For your convenience, subscriptions are set to Auto-Renew within the 24-hour period prior to the subscription end date. You can cancel your subscription at any moment in your iTunes account settings, but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the terms. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at purchase confirmation. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

HealthKit Integration

Zing integrates with HealthKit, allowing you to export exercise data and import fitness data and body measurements seamlessly.

Contact Us

Email: support@zing.coach
Instagram: @zing.coach

Transform your fitness journey with Zing Coach. Download now and start your personalized training experience today!

record.description_evidence:
No more guessing what to do next. SHRED’s AI-powered coaching gives you the structure, motivation, and personalization you need to reach your goals—lose weight, get stronger, or stay consistent. Every plan adapts to your progress and equipment, so you always know you’re training the right way for you. Your goals. Your coach. Your results.

Featured by Apple, Rolling Stone, Men’s Health, Women’s Health, GQ, PCMag, Business Insider, Goop, Garage Gym Reviews, and others.

PERSONALIZED TRAINING THAT EVOLVES WITH YOU
From day one, SHRED builds your plan around how you move and what you want to achieve. As you train, SHRED’s AI learns your patterns—how hard you push, how you recover, and when to advance or pull back. It automatically adjusts reps, sets, rest, and intensity to match your evolving strength and stamina. Gym or home, beginner or advanced—SHRED scales with you and keeps every workout challenging, efficient, and results-driven.

PROGRAMS ENGINEERED FOR REAL RESULTS
Explore expertly designed training paths in hypertrophy, powerlifting, strength, bodyweight, or sculpting. Every program is crafted by real coaches and refined by data from millions of workouts. Whether you’re chasing size, strength, or definition, SHRED’s system combines proven structure with adaptive progression so you keep improving week after week.

YOUR EQUIPMENT, OPTIMIZED
Have dumbbells, a rack, bands, kettlebells—or nothing at all? SHRED automatically adapts to your setup so you get the perfect workout wherever you train. Update your available gear anytime, and your workouts will instantly reconfigure to match your environment.

TALK TO YOUR COACH
Your coach doesn’t just listen—they lead. Get real-time feedback and guidance as your coach talks you through every workout. Hear precise cues on form, pacing, and intensity. When you’re ready to change things up, talk back to adjust your exercises, switch programs, or get nutrition advice. Whether you want to push harder, recover smarter, or refine your goals, your coach keeps you locked in and accountable—rep by rep.

TRAIN. TRACK. TRANSFORM.
Every workout is part of a bigger plan. Track your volume, consistency, and personal bests across programs with performance insights designed to keep you motivated. SHRED’s visual stats make it easy to see what’s working, where you’re improving, and how your dedication compounds into lasting progress.

COMPETE OR STAY PRIVATE
Join leaderboards, challenge friends, and send cheers—or train quietly on your own. SHRED’s community drives accountability without pressure. Celebrate streaks, share progress, and connect with people chasing their own goals at every level.

APPLE WATCH + HEALTH INTEGRATED
Go hands-free. Log every rep, track heart rate, control music, and sync progress—all from your wrist. SHRED connects seamlessly with Apple Health so your activity, calories, and recovery metrics are always in sync.

MORE YOU’LL LOVE
Studio Classes: HIIT, Yoga, Boxing, and more—led by elite coaches.
Deep Stats: See your progress, milestones, and consistency metrics in real time.
Support That Cares: Real human guidance when you need it.

SHRED PREMIUM
• Tens of thousands of workouts and elite programs
• Expert design and adaptive AI insights
• Talk to your coach for feedback, adjustments, and motivation
• Full Apple Watch experience
• Social competition and community features

Try it free for 7 days, or stay with the free version—no strings attached.
